title: Rules Every Physio Should Know — Canadian C-Spine, NEXUS and Wells

hook.en: A patient walks in after a road crash with neck pain. Another has a swollen calf after surgery. Doctors use short clinical rules to decide who needs an X-ray or a clot test. You will use the same rules to decide who you can treat, and who must go.
hook.ur: Ek mareez sadak ke hadsay ke baad gardan ke dard ke saath aata hai. Doosre ki surgery ke baad pindli soojhi hui hai. Doctors chhote clinical rules se tay karte hain ke kis ko X-ray ya clot test chahiye. Aap wohi rules istemal karenge yeh tay karne ke liye ke kis ka ilaaj ho sakta hai aur kis ko bhejna hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll use the Canadian C-spine rule and NEXUS after neck trauma, apply the Wells score to a swollen calf, know the people each rule was built for, and say when a rule must NOT be used.
goal.ur: End tak aap gardan ki chot ke baad Canadian C-spine rule aur NEXUS istemal karenge, soojhi pindli par Wells score lagayenge, jaanenge ke har rule kin logon ke liye bana hai, aur kab rule istemal NAHI karna.

text.en: A **clinical decision rule** is a short checklist that has been tested on thousands of patients. Its job is narrow: it helps a clinician decide whether a test is needed, or how likely a problem is. It does **not** make the diagnosis, and it works only for the kind of patient it was built for. The rules in this lesson are three of the most useful for a physiotherapist: two for the neck after trauma, and one for a possible leg clot.
text.ur: **Clinical decision rule** ek chhoti checklist hoti hai jo hazaaron mareezon par azmayi gayi ho. Iska kaam tang hai: yeh clinician ko tay karne mein madad deti hai ke test ki zaroorat hai ya nahi, ya masla kitna mumkin hai. Yeh diagnosis **nahi** karti, aur sirf usi qism ke mareez par chalti hai jis ke liye bani. Is lesson ke teen rules physiotherapist ke liye sab se mufeed mein se hain: do gardan ke trauma ke liye, aur ek mumkin taang ke clot ke liye.

text.en: Think of an **airport security gate**. It does not catch every problem, and it does not solve a crime. It quickly sorts passengers into "can go through" and "needs a closer look". A decision rule does the same: it sorts patients into "safe to carry on" and "needs the next step", and a good rule rarely lets a dangerous patient through the "safe" gate.
text.ur: **Airport ka security gate** sochein. Yeh har masla nahi pakadta aur jurm hal nahi karta. Yeh jaldi musafiron ko "guzar sakte hain" aur "qareeb se dekhna hai" mein baant deta hai. Decision rule bhi yahi karta hai: mareez ko "aage chalein" aur "agla qadam chahiye" mein baanta hai, aur achha rule khatarnak mareez ko shayad hi "mehfooz" gate se guzarne deta hai.

rows.en: Alert, stable adults after neck trauma (age 16 or over)
rows.ur: Hoshiyar, stable baaligh, gardan ki chot ke baad (16 saal ya zyada)

rows.en: No high-risk factor, a low-risk factor present, and able to rotate the neck 45 degrees both ways: X-ray not needed
rows.ur: Koi high-risk factor nahi, ek low-risk factor maujood, aur gardan dono taraf 45 degree ghuma sakte hain: X-ray ki zaroorat nahi

rows.en: Alert patients after blunt neck trauma
rows.ur: Hoshiyar mareez, gardan par kund chot ke baad

rows.en: All five present: no midline neck tenderness, no focal neurological deficit, normal alertness, no intoxication, no painful distracting injury: X-ray not needed
rows.ur: Paanchon maujood: gardan ke beech nazuki nahi, koi focal neurological nuqs nahi, hoshiyari normal, nasha nahi, koi dard bhari distracting chot nahi: X-ray ki zaroorat nahi

rows.en: A patient with a swollen or painful leg and no known clot
rows.ur: Soojhi ya dukhti taang ka mareez jis ko clot maloom nahi

rows.en: A score of 1 or less means a clot is unlikely and a blood test can often settle it; 2 or more means likely and needs imaging
rows.ur: Score 1 ya kam ka matlab clot mumkin nahi aur blood test aksar faisla kar deta hai; 2 ya zyada ka matlab mumkin hai aur imaging chahiye

title.en: The Canadian C-spine rule in three questions
title.ur: Canadian C-spine rule teen sawalon mein

steps.title: Any high-risk factor?
steps.detail: Age 65 or over; a dangerous mechanism (fall from about a metre or five stairs, a blow along the head, a high-speed crash, a rollover or ejection, a motorised recreational vehicle or a bicycle collision); or tingling in the arms or legs. If yes: imaging. || Koi high-risk factor?

steps.title: Any low-risk factor that makes it safe to test movement?
steps.detail: A simple rear-end crash, sitting in the waiting area, walking at any time, neck pain that began later, or no tenderness in the midline of the neck. If none: imaging. || Koi low-risk factor jis se harkat ka test mehfooz ho?

steps.title: Can the patient actively rotate the neck 45 degrees to the left and right?
steps.detail: If yes, the rule says an X-ray is not needed. If the patient cannot, or is not willing, imaging is needed. || Kya mareez gardan khud 45 degree dayen aur bayen ghuma sakta hai?

question.en: A 28-year-old was hit from behind in a car at low speed, walked out of the car, has had neck pain since the next morning, and has no midline neck tenderness. She can rotate her neck 60 degrees each way. What does the Canadian C-spine rule say?
question.ur: 28 saal ki khatoon ko gaari mein peechay se kam raftar par takrao hua, woh khud chal kar nikli, gardan ka dard agli subah se hai, aur gardan ke beech mein nazuki nahi. Woh gardan 60 degree dono taraf ghuma sakti hai. Canadian C-spine rule kya kehta hai?

text.en: She should not move her neck for a week
text.ur: Usay ek haftay gardan nahi hilani chahiye

feedback.en: Early movement is part of safe care; the rule supports it.
feedback.ur: Jaldi harkat mehfooz care ka hissa hai; rule isay support karta hai.

text.en: She needs an urgent X-ray because of the crash
text.ur: Hadsay ki wajah se usay urgent X-ray chahiye

feedback.en: The rule found no high-risk factor, so the crash alone does not force imaging.
feedback.ur: Rule ko koi high-risk factor nahi mila, isliye sirf hadsa imaging lazmi nahi karta.

text.en: No X-ray is needed; you can continue assessment and treat within your scope
text.ur: X-ray ki zaroorat nahi; aap assessment jaari rakh sakte hain aur apni scope mein ilaaj kar sakte hain

feedback.en: Yes — no high-risk factor, several low-risk factors and full rotation make a fracture very unlikely by this rule.
feedback.ur: Haan — koi high-risk factor nahi, kai low-risk factors aur poori rotation is rule ke mutabiq fracture ko bohat ghair mumkin banate hain.

question.en: A 70-year-old man has neck pain after a fall from a chair onto his head. Which step of the Canadian C-spine rule applies first?
question.ur: 70 saal ke mareez ko kursi se sar ke bal girne ke baad gardan ka dard hai. Canadian C-spine rule ka kaun sa qadam pehle lagta hai?

text.en: Age 65 or over is a high-risk factor, so he needs imaging before any neck treatment
text.ur: 65 saal ya zyada umar high-risk factor hai, isliye gardan ke kisi ilaaj se pehle imaging chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — one high-risk factor is enough to stop and send for imaging.
feedback.ur: Haan — ek high-risk factor rukne aur imaging ke liye bhejne ke liye kaafi hai.

text.en: Treat with gentle mobilisation and review
text.ur: Halki mobilisation se ilaaj aur review

feedback.en: Treatment before imaging is unsafe in a high-risk patient.
feedback.ur: High-risk mareez mein imaging se pehle ilaaj ghair mehfooz hai.

text.en: Check whether he can rotate his neck 45 degrees
text.ur: Dekhein ke woh gardan 45 degree ghuma sakta hai

feedback.en: Rotation is only tested if there is no high-risk factor.
feedback.ur: Rotation tab test hoti hai jab koi high-risk factor na ho.

text.en: **NEXUS** is simpler and stricter. If a patient meets all five low-risk criteria, the chance of a significant neck injury is very small. If **any one** is missing, imaging is needed. It works well in alert patients, but alcohol, drugs, a painful distracting injury or an altered state of mind make the patient unreliable. In those cases, do not rely on what the patient tells you.
text.ur: **NEXUS** ziyada saada aur sakht hai. Agar mareez paanchon low-risk criteria poore karta hai to gardan ki bari chot ka imkaan bohat kam hai. Agar **koi ek** bhi kam ho to imaging chahiye. Yeh hoshiyar mareezon mein achha chalta hai, lekin sharab, nasha, dard bhari distracting chot ya zehni halat ki tabdeeli mareez ko ghair mustanad bana deti hai. In halaat mein mareez ki baat par bharosa na karein.

title.en: The Wells score for a swollen leg: add one point for each of these, subtract two for the last (2 or more makes a clot likely)
title.ur: Soojhi taang ka Wells score: in mein se har ek par ek point jorein, aakhri par do ghatayein (2 ya zyada ka matlab clot mumkin hai)

steps.title: Active cancer, or treated within six months
steps.detail: Add one. || Active cancer, ya chhe mahine mein ilaaj

steps.title: Paralysis, weakness or a recent plaster cast on the leg
steps.detail: Add one. || Taang mein falij, kamzori ya haal ka plaster

steps.title: Bed-bound for three days or more, or major surgery in the last twelve weeks
steps.detail: Add one. || Teen din ya zyada bistar par, ya pichlay baarah haftay mein bari surgery

steps.title: Tenderness along the deep veins
steps.detail: Add one. || Gehri nasoon ke saath nazuki

steps.title: Whole leg swollen
steps.detail: Add one. || Poori taang soojhi hui

steps.title: Calf swollen by more than three centimetres compared with the other leg
steps.detail: Add one. || Pindli doosri se teen centimeter se zyada soojhi

steps.title: Pitting swelling only in the painful leg
steps.detail: Add one. || Sirf dukhti taang mein dabne wali soojan

steps.title: Visible surface veins that are not varicose
steps.detail: Add one. || Nazar aati sathi nasen jo varicose nahi

steps.title: Previous clot in the same leg
steps.detail: Add one. || Usi taang mein pehle clot

steps.title: Another diagnosis at least as likely as a clot
steps.detail: Subtract two. || Clot jitna ya zyada mumkin koi aur diagnosis

question.en: Four days after hip surgery a patient has a warm, swollen, tender calf. The calf is 4 centimetres larger than the other. He has been on bed rest. What is the right action?
question.ur: Hip surgery ke chaar din baad mareez ki pindli garam, soojhi aur nazuk hai. Pindli doosri se 4 centimeter bari hai. Woh bistar par raha hai. Sahi qadam kya hai?

text.en: Encourage a brisk walk to improve circulation
text.ur: Circulation behtar karne ke liye tez chalna

feedback.en: Exercise before a clot is excluded is unsafe.
feedback.ur: Clot rule out hone se pehle exercise ghair mehfooz hai.

text.en: Stop, do not massage or exercise the leg, and arrange urgent medical assessment for a possible clot
text.ur: Rukein, taang ki malish ya exercise na karein, aur mumkin clot ke liye urgent medical assessment karwayein

feedback.en: Yes — recent surgery, bed rest, calf swelling and tenderness already score at least 2, so a clot is likely.
feedback.ur: Haan — haal ki surgery, bistar ka aaram, pindli ki soojan aur nazuki pehle hi kam az kam 2 score banate hain, isliye clot mumkin hai.

text.en: Massage the calf to reduce swelling
text.ur: Soojan kam karne ke liye pindli ki malish

feedback.en: Massage could move a clot and cause a pulmonary embolism.
feedback.ur: Malish clot ko hila sakti hai aur pulmonary embolism kar sakti hai.

text.en: **Using a rule outside the people it was built for.** The Canadian C-spine rule was built for alert, stable adults; it does not cover children, people with an altered mental state, or those with a known spinal disorder. NEXUS fails in drunk or distracted patients, and Wells assumes no known clot. When your patient is outside the group, the rule's "safe" result does not apply: use your clinical judgement and refer.
text.ur: **Rule ko un logon par lagana jin ke liye woh nahi bana.** Canadian C-spine rule hoshiyar, stable baalighon ke liye bana hai; yeh bachon, badli hui zehni halat wale logon, ya jin ko pehle se reedh ka masla ho un ke liye nahi. NEXUS nashay mein ya dhyan bati hui halat mein fail ho jata hai, aur Wells farz karta hai ke clot maloom nahi. Jab aap ka mareez us group se bahar ho to rule ka "mehfooz" nateeja lagu nahi: apni clinical judgement istemal karein aur refer karein.

text.en: **Tell the patient the reason, not just the rule.** For example: "After a fall like yours, there is a small chance of a break in the neck bones. A simple checklist helps us decide who needs an X-ray. You need one, so I will not treat your neck until it is done. If it is clear, we will start straight away." This protects safety and trust at the same time.
text.ur: **Mareez ko rule nahi, wajah batayein.** Misaal: "Aap jaise girne ke baad gardan ki haddiyon ke tootne ka chhota sa imkaan hota hai. Ek saadi checklist se tay hota hai ke kis ko X-ray chahiye. Aap ko chahiye, isliye jab tak yeh na ho main aap ki gardan ka ilaaj nahi karunga. Agar saaf aaya to hum foran shuru kar denge." Isse hifazat aur bharosa dono bachte hain.

question.en: Why is the Canadian C-spine rule built to catch almost every injury, even if it sends some patients for X-rays they did not need?
question.ur: Canadian C-spine rule ko taqreeban har chot pakadne ke liye kyun banaya gaya hai, chahe woh kuch mareezon ko ghair zaroori X-ray ke liye bheje?

answer.en: Because the cost of missing a neck fracture is catastrophic (paralysis), while the cost of an extra X-ray is small. So the rule is set to be very **sensitive**: it rarely misses an injury, and accepts more false alarms. This is the right trade in an emergency, and the reason a "negative" rule is reassuring.
answer.ur: Kyunke gardan ka fracture miss hone ki qeemat tabahkun hai (falij), jabke ek ziyada X-ray ki qeemat chhoti hai. Isliye rule bohat **sensitive** rakha gaya hai: yeh shayad hi chot miss karta hai aur zyada jhoothe alarm qabool karta hai. Emergency mein yeh sahi sauda hai, aur isi liye "negative" rule tasalli deta hai.

beats.patient: A 34-year-old rugby player is tackled and falls on his head. He has neck pain with tingling in both hands, and he is alert and sober.
beats.assessment: Tingling in both hands is a high-risk factor in the Canadian C-spine rule (and a focal neurological sign for NEXUS), so imaging is needed before anything else.
beats.treatment: Do not move the neck. Keep the head and neck still, call emergency services, and monitor breathing and consciousness until help arrives. Do not test movement or apply any treatment.
beats.reassess: He is taken to hospital for imaging. You record the time, the findings and what you did, and share the note with the team.

text.en: **A positive rule means stop.** Do not test neck movement, treat or let the patient return to play after a high-risk neck injury, new neurological signs, or a swollen painful calf. Chest pain, sudden breathlessness or coughing blood after a leg clot suspicion is an emergency: call for help and keep the patient still.
text.ur: **Positive rule ka matlab rukna hai.** Gardan ki high-risk chot, naye neurological signs, ya soojhi dard bhari pindli ke baad harkat ka test, ilaaj ya khel mein wapsi na karein. Clot ke shak ke baad seene ka dard, achanak saans ki tangi ya khoon ki khansi emergency hai: madad bulayein aur mareez ko halne se rokein.

text.en: The Canadian C-spine rule was derived and validated in over 8,000 alert, stable trauma patients and was highly sensitive for important cervical spine injury. NEXUS, tested in about 34,000 patients, also had very high sensitivity but lower specificity; head-to-head studies favour the Canadian rule for fewer unnecessary X-rays. The Wells score, used with a D-dimer test, can exclude a leg clot safely when the score is low and the D-dimer is negative.
text.ur: Canadian C-spine rule 8,000 se zyada hoshiyar, stable trauma mareezon mein banaya aur parkha gaya aur ahem cervical spine chot ke liye bohat sensitive tha. NEXUS, taqreeban 34,000 mareezon par azmaya gaya, ki sensitivity bhi bohat zyada thi lekin specificity kam; aamne-saamne studies kam ghair zaroori X-rays ke liye Canadian rule ko tarjeeh deti hain. Wells score, D-dimer test ke saath, jab score kam aur D-dimer negative ho to taang ke clot ko mehfooz tareeqe se rule out kar sakta hai.

text.en: **Stop for the big three:** after neck trauma, stop for **age 65+, a dangerous mechanism, or tingling**; for a swollen leg, stop for **Wells 2 or more**; and in any rule, stop if the patient is **not the kind it was built for**.
text.ur: **Bari teen par ruken:** gardan ke trauma ke baad **65+ umar, khatarnak mechanism ya jhunjhuni** par ruken; soojhi taang mein **Wells 2 ya zyada** par ruken; aur kisi bhi rule mein, agar mareez **us qism ka nahi jis ke liye rule bana** to ruken.

summary.en: Decision rules sort patients into safe to carry on or needs the next step; they do not make the diagnosis.
summary.ur: Decision rules mareezon ko aage chalne ya agla qadam lene mein baantte hain; yeh diagnosis nahi karte.

summary.en: After neck trauma, any high-risk factor, tingling, or inability to rotate 45 degrees means imaging before treatment; NEXUS needs all five criteria.
summary.ur: Gardan ke trauma ke baad koi high-risk factor, jhunjhuni, ya 45 degree rotation na kar paana imaging se pehle ilaaj nahi; NEXUS ko paanchon criteria chahiye.

summary.en: A swollen, tender calf after surgery or bed rest is a possible clot: stop, do not massage or exercise, and refer the same day.
summary.ur: Surgery ya bistar ke baad soojhi, nazuk pindli mumkin clot hai: rukein, malish ya exercise na karein, aur usi din refer karein.

front.en: What are the five NEXUS criteria?
front.ur: NEXUS ke paanch criteria kaun se hain?

back.en: No midline neck tenderness, no focal neurological deficit, normal alertness, no intoxication, no painful distracting injury.
back.ur: Gardan ke beech nazuki nahi, focal neurological nuqs nahi, hoshiyari normal, nasha nahi, dard bhari distracting chot nahi.

front.en: Which age is a high-risk factor in the Canadian C-spine rule?
front.ur: Canadian C-spine rule mein kaun si umar high-risk factor hai?

front.en: What Wells score makes a leg clot likely?
front.ur: Kaun sa Wells score taang ke clot ko mumkin banata hai?

front.en: When must you NOT use a rule?
front.ur: Rule kab istemal NAHI karna chahiye?

back.en: When the patient is not the kind of person the rule was built for.
back.ur: Jab mareez us qism ka na ho jis ke liye rule bana.

note.en: The wider set of imaging rules.
note.ur: Imaging ke rules ka wasi set.

note.en: Safety checks before any neck treatment.
note.ur: Gardan ke kisi bhi ilaaj se pehle hifazati checks.
